title: Hunts FH-041S: Owner and operator sign the Stripe and progressive dinner pilot gate

source.ref: Split from FH-041 (2026-11-16): the test matrix and the gate record shipped; the human gates did not.

detail: Requires FH-041, FH-036T, FH-035 and the Hunt commerce migrations applied. Owed by people, not by an agent. The owner (Daniel) has declined real-card test runs for now, so this stays open until he chooses to run them: (1) a controlled real sale and a real refund on the pilot Hunt in the approved live account, reconciled with checks 1 to 4 in docs/hunts/PILOT-COMMERCE.md; (2) payout proof for that sale (check 5: transfer and payout read from Stripe); (3) the pilot operator sets wave capacity, walks the route and accepts the recovery steps; (4) the operator and the owner approve the participant terms. Each person fills in their own row of the sign-off table. Done when: the owner adds, on its own line in that doc, the words PILOT SIGNED OFF BY OWNER followed by a colon, his name and the date as YYYY-MM-DD. No agent writes that line or fills in a row.
